checks.detail: Ordinary boot, movement and fire reached authoritative gameplay before fixtures. Alpha preparation resolved three stable distributed ids with grounded occupancy, clear capsules and greater than seven-meter separation; explicit advance exposed search motion and navigation desired/safe velocities without the prior mouse_captured error. The required uninterrupted Bravo five, Charlie ten, perception, flank, cover, reciprocal shot, reload, hit-reaction and death matrix was not completed. coverage.baseline.accelerated_branch_setup.7ee212621d20=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence;

AK-74M and Saiga-12 switching was atomic. Three distinct recoil snapshots bound FPSViewmodelSwitcher transform and WeaponController state before firing, after held-fire release and after physical F6 reset; both recovery samples reported trigger_held=false, fire_action_down=false, active_state=hip, viewmodel_position_error=0, viewmodel_rotation_error=0, recoil_phase=settled and recovery complete, with local pose restored to position (0.1,-0.23,0.015) and rotation (0,0,0). Only the Alpha search slice supplied adjacent enemy animation state; rifle fire/reload, hurt, death, grounded locomotion semantics, both viewmodel hand-contact matrices and the success-camera victory dance were not qualified. coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_animation_semantics.b0796d84f6aa=insufficient_evidence;
Candidate source and bound gameplay frames still violate the equipped-weapon HUD or player-paced story-cue contract.

The failure fixture produced one authoritative bomb_detonated terminal commit, disabled control and reached a replay/home result, but the explosion rendered mainly as opaque emissive spheres, flat bars and primitive debris rather than a readable layered flash, fire, sparks, debris, shockwave and dust sequence. The success defusal, combat freeze, safe third-person camera, user-facing victory dance and score/time/rank path was not executed.

Navigate title, briefing/loading, loadout, gameplay, pause, settings, ordinary death recovery, success result, failure result and replay using keyboard/mouse and gamepad. Require coherent grounded typography and transparent AAA-style information hierarchy, visible focus/hover/pressed states, truthful paused HUD snapshot, readable 200 percent UI scale, subtitles, motion reduction and persisted settings. Reject default fonts, card grids, large opaque color blocks, deep-blue borders, slash-slash labels, debug text, focus traps or direct boot into gameplay.

Exact source review separated all registered 3D-fps-map layers: main.gd owns sky daylight, shadows and SSAO with background 0.8, ambient 0.85, sky contribution 0.75, FILMIC, SSAO 1.2/1.25/1.35 and shadowed sun energy 1.8; clouds.gdshader owns two unshaded drifting cloud sheets; sun_flare.gd owns camera/sun-bound additive screen-space flare without changing exposure. Candidate runtime binds sky, shadows, SSAO, clouds and flare directly, but matched gameplay frames still clip sunlit material detail, crush shaded-route readability and remain substantially less layered than the bound industrial reference. Footstep owner/source inspection was completed, but walking and sprinting mixed output was not captured. component.background_energy_multiplier=0.8; component.ambient_light_energy=0.85; component.ambient_light_sky_contribution=0.75; component.tonemap_mode=filmic; component.tonemap_exposure=1; component.ssao_enabled=true; component.ssao_radius=1.2; component.ssao_intensity=1.25; component.ssao_power=1.35; component.direct_sun_energy=1.8; candidate.background_energy_multiplier=0.8; candidate.ambient_light_energy=0.85; candidate.ambient_light_sky_contribution=0.75; candidate.tonemap_mode=filmic; candidate.tonemap_exposure=1; candidate.ssao_enabled=true; candidate.ssao_radius=1.2; candidate.ssao_intensity=1.25; candidate.ssao_power=1.35; candidate.direct_sun_energy=1.8; coverage.baseline.environment_component_layers.68addfde8e62=fail; coverage.baseline.fps_footstep_integrity.5372f6aa2769=insufficient_evidence;

Editor and runtime error logs remained clean after movement, firing, reload, F6 recovery, Alpha setup and terminal failure. A fresh unpaused captured-mouse sequence bound yaw -150.018 to -160.102, pitch 0 to 7.563 and mouse_captured true to true while preserving two distinct in-sequence frames; W/A/S/D, jump recovery, pause/resume, R reload-only and F6 safe-spawn restoration also responded. The collector used llvmpipe, did not match 1920x1080 and sampled about 133 ms frames; the complete mission and three replay cycles therefore remain unqualified. Loadout and failure results also remain text-led card/stat dumps. coverage.baseline.fps_shell_information_presentat.40d0f2cd0a9e=fail; coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=insufficient_evidence;

Issue one integrated verdict for the complete Fusepoint vertical slice across world, movement, both weapons, 18 enemies, A/B capture, C defusal, HUD/minimap, story, audio/VFX, ordinary death, success, detonation failure, menus, accessibility and restart stability. Require continuous current-candidate evidence and name the highest-impact blocker; source inspection, labels, beauty frames or self-reported completion are insufficient.

required_criteria.requirement: Play fresh uninterrupted encounters against the required 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie enemies. Verify multiple spatial clusters, autonomous locomotion, navigation separation, perception, search, flank, cover reservation, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hit reaction and death. Reject static or duplicated enemies, first-frame fire, wall tracking, teleporting, sliding poses, overlapping capsules, doorway deadlocks, frozen groups or damage without a real enemy shot event.

Inspect continuous motion for player weapons/hands and all visible enemy states. Require stable roots and sockets, weapon-hand contact, locomotion without foot sliding, readable aim/fire/hurt/death transitions, no T-pose or transform-only substitute, and third-person victory dance framing that faces the user after combat freezes.

Bind state logs, continuous frames and audio for player/enemy fire, near miss, material impact, player damage, enemy hit, kill and death. Require synchronized muzzle flash, animation, recoil, projectile/tracer or pellet result, occlusion, impact VFX/audio, red edge damage mask, camera response and a restrained right-side yellow kill notification such as 'YOU KILLED' without opaque cards or debug labels. Enemy death must have clear animation and sound feedback.

Execute both terminal paths from ordinary gameplay. Success must atomically defuse before zero, freeze combat, move to a safe third-person camera, play the character victory dance, show score/time/rank and offer replay/home. Failure must atomically detonate at zero, set health to zero once, disable combat, layer flash/fire/sparks/debris/shockwave/dust/light/audio, shake then lower the camera, expand and decay the red damage mask, play the failure video or still fallback, and offer retry/home without a generic Game Over label.

Review daylight environment lighting, neutral exposure, contact shadows and event-driven audio/VFX across the complete mission. Require readable real materials, distinct weapon/mechanical/footstep/impact/enemy/objective/bomb/dialogue/ambience/music layers, bounded effects with world scale and surface response, and no clipping. Reject overexposure, bloom flicker, missing geometry during camera motion, darkness/fog/post effects hiding weak assets, silent kills or one sound/effect reused for unrelated events.

Run the complete mission at 1920x1080 after initial load with raw frame-time samples and repeat restart/replay three times. Target 60 FPS and no sustained explosion dip below 45 FPS for three frames. Reject fatal Godot errors, crash, soft lock, input/camera/collision escape, duplicated enemies or events, unbounded particles/audio/corpses/signals, navigation deadlock, texture shimmer, disappearing map surfaces or state drift after restart.
